transcript: Speaker A: Namaskar, ek badi khabar hai, ab English seekhna bilkul mushkil nahi raha. Aa chuka hai ek aisa app jo aapko Hindi mein hi English bolna sikhata hai, naam hai Speak Easy app. Is app mein aap bina kisi dar ya sharam ke aam bolchaal ki English seekh sakte hain. Na lambe lectures, na koi mote books, yahan milte hain mazedaar aur aasan do se paanch minute ke lectures jo aapki daily life ke hisaab se design kiye gaye hain. Aur sabse kamaal ki baat, ismein aapko milti hai ek personal AI teacher, jo hamesha aapke liye available hai. Jitni baar chahe galti karein, bina gussa hue ya judge kiye ye aapko turant sahi rasta dikhati hai. Toh der kis baat ki, neeche diye gaye install button par abhi click karein aur Speak Easy app download karein. [Hello, there is big news, now learning English is not difficult at all. An app has arrived that teaches you to speak English in Hindi itself, its name is Speak Easy app. In this app, you can learn conversational English without any fear or shame. No long lectures, no thick books, here you get fun and easy two to five-minute lectures designed according to your daily life. And the most amazing thing, in this you get a personal AI teacher, who is always available for you. Make mistakes as many times as you want, without getting angry or judging, she shows you the right path instantly. So why the delay, click on the install button below right now and download the Speak Easy app.]
on_screen_text: BREAKING NEWS, SpeakEasy AI, DOWNLOAD, Speak English Confidently in 100 Days for Only ‑1, Install, Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy
summary: A presenter introduces the SpeakEasy app, highlighting its fear-free English learning approach using Hindi. It features short 2-5 minute daily lessons and a personal AI teacher that corrects mistakes without judgment. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app.
